description:
Found 2026-08-12 (op-62vf). Recorded as UNRESOLVED rather than guessed at.

SYMPTOM. With a saturated 7 MPa start, alpha_g = 1e-4 and a 10 um bubble diameter, the ramped blowdown survives 11 steps and then fails with:

  TAMPINES numerical failure: volume constraint alpha_g + alpha_l = 1 is violated by
  0.0012295274121916222 after 20 outer correctors at t = 0.00036 s, above the 1e-4 limit

i.e. the outer-corrector Newton iteration on the volume residual stops converging. The same configuration at 1 mm bubbles fails differently (the metastable-bound refusal, separate bead), and the 10 um run is otherwise BETTER behaved -- the phase-temperature difference falls from 49.8 K to 5.74 K, which is the interfacial closures working as intended.

WHAT IS KNOWN.
- The Newton system is the correct quasi-Jacobian: M = -(V/dt) dR/dp, assembled from the compliance C_i = sum_k alpha_k psi_k / rho_k on the diagonal and the pressure-corrected face fluxes off it. It is strictly diagonally dominant.
- The compressibilities psi_k are taken along the isentropic path (dh_k = dp/rho_k), which is the path the step actually takes; using the fixed-enthalpy derivative instead was measured to stall the correctors and was fixed on 2026-08-12.
- Under-relaxation is 0.7 and 20 correctors were allowed.

LEADING HYPOTHESIS, NOT VERIFIED. The residual R(p) is not smooth in p once the mass-transfer rate limiter (MAX_MASS_TRANSFER_FRACTION_PER_STEP) and the residual-alpha phase floor (PHASE_FLOOR_TRIGGER) switch on and off between correctors. Newton on a piecewise residual does not converge. The failing run showed those branches firing on most cells (lim = 22-24, floor = 30 of 24 cells over both stages). If that is right, the fix is to make the branch decisions once per STEP rather than once per corrector, or to smooth the limiter.

DO NOT paper over this by raising MAX_VOLUME_RESIDUAL. The refusal is correct: a step whose phases do not fill the cell to better than 1e-4 has not converged, and returning it would give a density field wrong by the residual.

NEXT STEP: instrument the corrector loop to print R and max|dp| per corrector for the failing step, and check whether the limiter/floor branch set changes between correctors.
title: tampines TwoFluid1d: outer-corrector Newton fails to converge the volume constraint at small bubble diameter -- UNDIAGNOSED

description:
Additive, non-breaking tensor/vector-field FV operators translated from vendored OpenFOAM (commit 481094fd), flagged blocking by the GeN-Foam thermo-mechanics port (op-p6p.11):

1. fvc::grad_vec: VolVectorField -> VolTensorField (Gauss grad, outer(Sf,u_f))
2. fvc::div_tensor: VolTensorField -> VolVectorField; fvc::div_symm_tensor: VolSymmTensorField -> VolVectorField (Gauss div, Sf & sigma_f)
3. fvm::d2dt2: implicit Euler 2nd time-derivative for VolVectorField -> FvVectorMatrix
4. fvm::Sp / fvm::Su / fvm::su_sp: implicit + explicit source terms (scalar & vector)
5. Field-level tensor algebra: tr/symm/two_symm/dev/dev2 on VolTensorField/VolSymmTensorField

Translated from src/finiteVolume/finiteVolume/{fvc/fvcGrad,fvc/fvcDiv,fvm/fvmSup,fvm/fvmD2dt2} + gaussGrad/gaussDivScheme/EulerD2dt2Scheme. V&V tests: grad(A.x)=A^T, div(linear tensor)=known const, d2dt2(quadratic-in-t)=const. Unblocks op-p6p.11 (deferred GeN-Foam thermoMechanics/TH mesh solves).

notes.author: teddy0@snrsi-arch-desktop
notes.content:
DONE 2026-07-15. Added (all additive, non-breaking):
fvc::grad_vec (VolVectorField->VolTensorField, gaussGrad outer(Sf,u_f)); fvc::div_tensor + fvc::div_symm_tensor (Vol[Symm]TensorField->VolVectorField, gaussDivScheme Sf&sigma); fvm::d2dt2 + d2dt2_coeff (VolVectorField ->FvVectorMatrix, EulerD2dt2Scheme, constant-dt); fvm::{sp,su,su_sp,sp_vec,su_vec,su_sp_vec} (fvmSup, OpenFOAM signs: Sp diag+=V*sp, Su source-=V*su); fields::vol_field_algebra::{tr,tr_of_symm,symm,two_symm,two_symm_of_symm,dev,dev2,dev_of_symm,dev2_of_symm}. Added PatchField::{zero_gradient_tensor,fixed_value_tensor,zero_gradient_symm_tensor,fixed_value_symm_tensor}. 13 new V&V tests, all pass (grad(A.x)=A^T; div(linear tensor)=x-row of M; d2dt2(quadratic-in-t)=2c; Sp/Su solve k.phi=S). cargo test -p outram-foam-basic-lib --lib --release: 245 passed 0 failed 4 ignored. Android aarch64-linux-android check clean. clippy clean on new files. No existing public signatures changed. Unblocks op-p6p.11 (GeN-Foam thermoMechanics DEqn/TEqn). Follow-up for op-p6p.11: no fvm::laplacian(tensor-coeff) or explicit non-orthogonal correction; grad_vec is single Gauss pass; d2dt2 assumes constant dt + non-moving mesh (no V0/V00 history in FvMesh).

title: Tensor/vector FV operators for GeN-Foam thermoMechanics (unblocks op-p6p.11)
